notes.title: Rebellion Starts with L33na Redpepper – Are You Ready?
notes.notes:
[h3]In [i]L33na Redpepper[/i], you don’t just play an android—you become a revolution. Built with attention to narrative detail and cinematic presentation, the game merges emotional depth with mechanical precision. L33na isn’t just another protagonist—she's a symbol of rebellion, trauma, and unresolved longing.
This game explores freedom, identity, and power in a world where androids are disposable. Through intense close-quarters combat and haunting flashbacks, you’ll see through the eyes of a machine who feels far too much.
Developed using Unity’s URP pipeline, the lighting and animation push 2.5D design to its narrative edge. If you want a game that dares to bleed and burn, L33na Redpepper is for you. [/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805390/L33na_Redpepper/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][/h3]

notes.title: L33na, the killer sex doll is coming!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! After two years without releasing a new game, we’re thrilled to announce the launch of [i]L33na Redpepper[/i], our newest project and a big step forward for our studio.[/p][p]Our previous games were made using much older versions of Unity, which limited what we could achieve. Now, with [i]L33na[/i], we’re exploring modern Unity features like URP and HDRP, and writing much cleaner, more efficient code. We’re tackling two major priorities: improving FPS while delivering better visual quality, and minimizing bugs for a smoother experience. While we focused on refining this new project, much of the technology and features we’re developing for [i]L33na[/i] will also help us enhance some of our older games in the future. For those who have supported us since the beginning, we have a special surprise waiting — check it out on the game page![/p][p]We’re excited to share this new chapter with you and hope you enjoy the journey as much as we do![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805390/L33na_Redpepper/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286292/3dd2b276cfffa8415ff33684b29c5ad69d0ec140.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

We will release an update that will fix all current issues with this Early Access game. The game's narrative structure will be fixed as well.

notes.title: 1st Regular Update 31 December 2021
notes.notes:
The 1st Regular Update is scheduled to be released on December 31, 2021.
The objective is to fix bugs in every level of the game and expand the Pornocrates Osiris's Seed universe.
This update requires you to completely uninstall the previous version to install the new update.

Some items that will be fixed:
Abandon the testing process and introduce ONE DEFINITE, PLAYABLE version (the Game is EARLY ACCESS AND WILL CONTINUE THAT WAY FOR TWO MORE MONTHS).

Although the game has passed the minimum requirements for Early Access, we believe it needs a lot of improvement. Let's not wait for the definitive release to introduce an acceptable game. We will do this as soon as possible.

Eliminate bugs in Cutscenes.
Equip the Villain of the story.
Fix Save System and other BUGS (because there are many).
Etc...
